notes.title: Update 1.0.0 Release
notes.notes:
lone.AI 1.0.0 Update
With this update, lone.AI is now available! Thank you to everyone who helped test and provide feedback. Moving forward, lone.AI will continue to receive updates and fixes based on community input. This update introduces run missions, visual enhancements, and more. Below is a full list of changes.

NEW Run Missions

Each run features a mission for rewards that can be rerolled.
Unlock: [spoiler]Win one time.[/spoiler]

Locations

NEW A reroll stat has been added to the information tab at the AI Station.
NEW The casino game can now be rerolled once per run.
The delay for fast sell has been decreased.
Some menus have been enhanced.
Fixed Necula's shot cooldown allowing multiple upgrades at once.

Modules

NEW Reveal Module: [spoiler]Reveals all skills in the skill tree.[/spoiler]
NEW Glitch Module: [spoiler]Periodically does something random.[/spoiler]
NEW Glycerol Module: [spoiler]Applies toxic damage to a nearby enemy.[/spoiler]
NEW Whysoad Module: [spoiler]Fires a sound wave at random.[/spoiler]
NEW Music Module: [spoiler]Periodically fires music notes.[/spoiler]
Including all modules this brings the total number to 59.
Fixed module chest not spawning when two are bought simultaneously.

Other

NEW Steam achievements have now been implemented, with a total of 34 achievements.
Changed the gameplay background.
Made some HUD displays look more appealing.
Boss music has been added.
Adjusted number rounding on some stats.
The EULA has been removed.
Other minor bug fixes and changes.


Digital Drank

notes.title: lone.AI Loot Update
notes.notes:
lone.AI Beta 0.9.0 Update
This update introduces an improved looting system. Combined with the previous rerolls update and other additions, it becomes much easier to create your build. Below is a complete list of the changes.

NEW Object Info

All loot and objects now display more detailed info when targeted or hovered over.
Modules now show their name, description, some stats, and rerolls.
Pickups now show their name, description, and some stats.
Enemies now display their names and more when using specific modules.

Abilities

Added three new abilities that you can choose from at the beginning of a new run.
NEW Melee Ability: [spoiler]Deal a powerful frontal attack.[/spoiler]
NEW Module Ability: [spoiler]Chance to spawn a module chest; using it increases the chances.[/spoiler]
NEW Repair Ability: [spoiler]Repairs a small portion of the hull.[/spoiler]
Changed how mines deal damage.

Locations

NEW Secret: [spoiler]An unmapped planet is now functional.[/spoiler]
NEW Secret: [spoiler]A rare station can spawn and be available for use.[/spoiler]
Beacon objectives now have a navigation arrow when within range.
More dialog options and responses unlock as you progress.

Modules

NEW Scanner Module: [spoiler]The targeted enemy displays its current hull.[/spoiler]
NEW Attack Damage Module: [spoiler]Increases attack damage, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
NEW Plasma Damage Module: [spoiler]Increases plasma damage, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
NEW Shot Spawner Module: [spoiler]Periodically drops a basic shot.[/spoiler]
NEW Plasma Spawner Module: [spoiler]Periodically drops a plasma shot.[/spoiler]
Including all modules this brings the total number to 54.
Changed spread shot module to random spread up to 360 degrees.
Changed extra shots module to add one fewer bullet per shot.

Skill Tree

NEW Added five new skills as roll options in the skill tree.
Added Fire Back, Spinning Laser, Plasma Orbit, AI Dialog Shot, and Module skills.
Fixed plasma orbiting shot from disappearing after using a portal.
You can no longer purchase the repair skill if your hull is already full.

Other

Overhauled much of the HUD information for better clarity and usability.
Added an aimer when using the controller twin setting.
Fixed various bugs that occurred when using a controller.
Added notification for when a remote access not unlocked is used.
Other minor bug fixes and changes.


Digital Drank

notes.title: lone.AI Update Rerolls
notes.notes:
lone.AI Beta 0.8.0 Update
This update adds the reroll feature, making it easier to craft your build by rerolling modules. Below is a complete list of the changes.

NEW Rerolls

Start with limited rerolls to reroll dropped modules.
Rerolls can be increased in multiple ways.

Locations

Added reroll rewards for completing certain missions.
Decreased mist surrounding AI Station.
More dialog options and responses unlock as you progress.

Modules

NEW Rerolls Module: [spoiler]Increases rerolls by five, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
NEW Rerolls Super Module: [spoiler]Increases rerolls by 99 and spawns a module chest, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
Including all modules this brings the total number to 49.
Decreased experience received when destroying a module chest.
Moved the module text information over.

Pickups

NEW Reroll Pickup: [spoiler] Increases rerolls by one.[/spoiler]
This brings the total number of pickups to 10.
Gas and nova pickups are now triggered when hit by basic shots.
Fixed an issue where some pickups would not spawn correctly.

Skill Tree

NEW Added rerolls skill as roll options in the skill tree.
Plasma orbit size increases with the increase plasma shot Size skill.
Plasma shot will now create an explosion when using the piercing skill.

AI Dialog Box

AI dialog text typing now continues when paused.
Enhanced the helpfulness of the tutorial.
Slightly reduced font size for AI dialog text.

Other

Reduced collision damage frequency with certain ships.
Fixed controller cursor from being hidden behind certain objects.
Other minor bug fixes and changes.


Digital Drank

notes.title: Update 0.7.0 Beta
notes.notes:
lone.AI Beta 0.7.0 Update
This update introduces new features such as a damage dealt display, the treasure ship, and more. Below is a complete list of the changes.

NEW Treasure Ship

[spoiler]A rare ship can spawn, dropping random pickups and a module chest.[/spoiler]

NEW The Void

[spoiler]The Void can be accessed by flying out of the solar system.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]The Void is a more dangerous area with its own enemies and mysteries.[/spoiler]

Locations

NEW Secret: [spoiler]An unmapped planet is now functional.[/spoiler] 
Decreased the defeat requirements for unlocking Thonia Remote Access.
Added more AI dialog tips to the AI Station.
More dialog options and responses unlock as you progress.

Damage:

NEW Added numbers to the game to display damage dealt and received.
The damage numbers display can be toggled on and off in the main menu.
Changed the collision box for Nova attacks.
Adjusted damage reductions for various ships and attacks.
Modified how some attacks and modules deal damage.

Modules

NEW Armor Module: [spoiler]Increases damage reduction, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
NEW Acceleration Module: [spoiler]Increases acceleration, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
NEW Speed Module: [spoiler]Increases maximum speed, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler]
Including all modules this brings the total number to 47.
The Striker module can now be acquired multiple times.

Skill Tree

NEW Added back shot and side shot skills as roll options in the skill tree.
Orbiting shots will no longer stack over each other when purchased simultaneously.

Other

Updated the turret ability to stay active until a new turret is placed.
Decreased the defeat requirements for unlocking the missile ability.
Decreased the defeat requirements for unlocking the auto fire upgrade.
Changed the color of the explosive hit effect.
Made a slight change to the shield pickup's color.
Changed the ship's HUD display settings to save the current selection.
Made some adjustments to the speed and acceleration of certain enemy ships.
The 'Game Over' text is now replaced with 'Victory' when the game is won.
An additional easter egg has been added.
Other minor bug fixes and changes.

notes.title: Update 0.0.8 For Alpha Testers
notes.notes:
lone.AI Alpha 0.0.8 Update
Thank you to everyone testing lone.AI. I've received your feedback and taken all of it into consideration. The majority of comments were about the game's difficulty being too high. I've made adjustments to the difficulty settings, along with several other updates. Below is a list of additions and changes in lone.AI Alpha Build 0.0.8.

Locations

Crouka Slime is now fully functional.
Crouka Slime: [spoiler]Purchase an upgrade for your chosen ability.[/spoiler] 
Midway Casino is now fully functional.
Midway Casino: [spoiler]Each run the casino can have a different game to win credits or prizes.[/spoiler] 
Portals are now available to teleport to at the beginning of each run once unlocked.
Portals Unlock: [spoiler]AI Station, Gavis, and Thonia remote access unlocked.[/spoiler]
Portals: [spoiler]Each portal has permanent stat upgrades available.[/spoiler]
This brings the total number of functional locations to eight:
Crouka Slime, Midway Casino, Gavis, Thonia, the AI Station, and the Portals.

NEW Traveling Merchant

[spoiler]The traveling merchant may be found visiting many locations.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]The traveling merchant deals in food, luxury goods, and offers a module chest for sale.[/spoiler]

Modules

NEW Laser Module: [spoiler]Periodically creates a spinning laser.[/spoiler] 
NEW Extra Shots Module: [spoiler]Adds extra bullets per shot, can be acquired multiple times.[/spoiler] 
NEW Spread Shot Module: [spoiler]Shot spread is random.[/spoiler] 
NEW Auto Fire Module: [spoiler]Automatically fires your shots.[/spoiler] 
NEW Slime Module: [spoiler]Unlocks Crouka Slime remote access.[/spoiler] 
NEW Casino Module: [spoiler]Unlocks Midway Casino remote access.[/spoiler] 
This brings the total number of modules to 22.
Added a highlight around dropped modules.
Added an animation on module icons when first acquired.
Slightly increased module chest spawn chance.

Decreased Difficulty

Decreased the amount of initial enemies that will spawn.
Decreased the damage of enemies basic attack.
Added Survivor Bonus: [spoiler]Gain credits for every minute survived.[/spoiler] 
Decreased vortex speed.
Increased wrench pickup repair amount.
Increased credits pickup amount.
Increased rewards for destroying enemies.

Other

The game now stays paused when exiting a menu or location.
Other minor bug fixes and changes.


Digital Drank
